notes.title: Optimization update v 0.0.8 O
notes.notes:
[b]- Optimization update v.0.0.8 O - [/b]

[b]Technical Improvements & Optimization[/b]

-Landscape Optimization: Significant improvements to landscape rendering and foliage assets have been implemented, resulting in increased performance and higher frame rates across the map.

-Core Gameplay Optimization: A full pass on various gameplay systems has been completed, enhancing the game's overall performance and stability.

-Enemy AI Logic Refactor: The logic and movement code for all enemy AI has been completely refactored and optimized. This update yields an average 30% improvement in AI processing speed, leading to more responsive enemies and better overall CPU performance.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Inventory Persistence: Fixed an issue where save and load functions would improperly flush out certain inventory items. All items should now correctly persist upon loading a saved game.

- Re-building System Fix: Addressed and corrected save and load issues reported by users regarding the re-building system.

Please ensure your game is updated to the latest version to benefit from these changes. If you encounter any new issues, please report them on the Steam forums.

notes.title: v 0.0.8 N
notes.notes:
This update focuses on streamlining resource management, improving clarity in the UI, and fixing some long-standing quirks. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Worker Assignment to Buildings[/b]

You can now assign workers directly to production buildings! Once assigned, they’ll automatically collect resources for you. Less micromanagement, more empire building.
Gathering stations : can automate only gathering / collecting specific resources
Mining station : can automate only mining resources
Lumber yard : can automate wood and sticks
Resource refining buildings like smelter, tanner, loom and cooking spit can refine resources into finished usable items, however the previous crafting requirements are already in your inventory.


[b]Smarter Refining UI[/b]
Resource inputs are now added automatically when dragging and dropping into refining stations like the Smelter, Loom, Cooking, and Tanner.

[b]Unit Skills Display[/b]
Skills now correctly appear in the Skills Menu on load. Huge thanks to Kojastro for helping track this down!

[b]Pause Menu Cleanup[/b]
The Restart Level option has been removed from the pause menu to reduce accidental restarts and streamline the interface. Thanks to HunterTheWolf

[b]Construction Fix[/b]
Attempting to build when not able to build due to collision with objects or uneven surfaces will no longer deduct resources. Your stockpiles are safe!

That’s all for now—but we’ve got more updates on the horizon. As always, thank you for your feedback, bug reports, and support

notes.title: v 0.0.8 m
notes.notes:
[b]Development Update:[/b]

[b]Crowdsourced Translations[/b]

The Google Sheet for translations is now live. Community members are encouraged to contribute translations for their respective languages.

[b]UI and Input Improvements[/b]

Keyboard support added: Pressing Escape or Backspace will now exit the Resource Refinement Building UI.

Partial controller support added (including sensitivity adjustments).

[b]Gameplay Fixes and Features[/b]

Animals were despawning unexpectedly due to distance or certain triggers. This has now been resolved.

Resource Refinement Buildings (Smelter, Loom, Tanner, Cooking Pit) now persistently save both input and output resources.

Non-interactable resources placed near broken buildings are now fixed and can be interacted with.

Animal disappearance issue has been fixed. Special thanks to SteelCzar for the report.

notes.title: New enemy levels, fighting styles. Introduction of Immortals & Finishing moves
notes.notes:
Hey everybody ! 

I have added new enemies in the game which are the Immortals.
These units are higher difficulty than the normal Persians in the game and they have a completely different fighting style.
Along with that the regular persians which have different levels have also different fighting styles now.
Level 1-2 easiest fighting style. They are stupid they just follow and attack.
Level 3-5 strategic fighting style. These enemies evaluate where and how to attack.
Level 6-8 Immortals, they evaluate before attacking and also they have special combos.
Level 9 Immortal [ not yet implemented WIP ] these will have a completely different style of fighting and probably different weapons as well.
Level 10 - Wizard [ not yet implemented WIP]
Level 11 - General : kind of like a boss battle, they will be present in only few camps. [ not yet implemented WIP ]

I also worked on creating finishers for the player.
If the player can time the counter, the enemy goes into STUN mode and where it can be countered. 


Here is a video of the new immortals level 6-8 
https://youtu.be/XEMOzxpzP_o

notes.title: Healing at the campfire Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !

It has been quite some time since the last update regarding the prologue demo. I have been hard at work since the demo release with adding more features, fixing issues, balancing the game and making the game more user friendly.

More than 110 action items are knocked off the to do list which i see as a huge win.
- Redid character movement logic
- Redid a lot of movement animations
- Created more UIs for user information
- Created better crafting mechanics
- Camp takeover logic improved
- Improved battle mechanics
- Improved healing feature
- Created allied units updates


Please do follow the game here and on discord to know more about the updates.

In the image you can see the new units healing process. Player can create campfire and the units will automatically sit and rest near it.
It will heal the units and also reduce overall fatigue.

I am also hard at work on the game to meet the deadlines of the upcoming Steam festivals. Stay tuned for new demo in the festival !
